sourceFile: 08. TIU C11-20  Report test VP cutting Dry 6hr -12hr -24hr from Sub1 check Function  2025.12.29_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Comparable evidence exists, but the draft misgroups the changed factor and includes invalid header-derived measurements.
issues: Changed condition incorrectly treats Day Shift as a process condition and omits 6h from changed conditions.
Model and 6h condition are misplaced as subgroup keys.
Tension outcome only supports 6h test vs normal, not 12h or 24h.
Measurement-2 is derived from a header row and should not be a measurement outcome.
Evidence row Test!21 is cited but not provided in context text.
correctionPlan: Redefine factor as VP cut dry 6h, 12h, 24h at SMT/forming versus normal dry 24h at VP line.
Keep date, shift, model, and joint type as context or subgroup keys only.
Limit function outcome to rows 22, 24, 26, and 28 with three test comparisons versus normal.
Limit tension outcome to 6h test versus normal, grouped by VP+COIL and FRAME+VP.
Remove Measurement-2 or convert defect-category details only if source rows support them.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Main row citations are sufficient for function and tension, but header-only derived evidence is insufficient.
